local_v39_pillow_decode.method: Exact provenance-listed v39 route files only; Pillow verify then load; this is a local file decode check, not browser DOM observation.

guide_layers.interpretation: The six guide-preview groups (22 images) and three guide-image-collection groups (39 images) are separate guide/source layers. They are not native screenshot target identities. The all50 browser pass observed and decoded the 22 preview images; it observed no guide-collection image route in the gallery pages or Zul'Aman wrapper. The 39-image count and local decode are recorded separately.

interpretation.native_grid: All 50 gallery pages exposed their first-page native grid cells as the local missing-image.svg fallback. native_image_404s=0 means those fallback SVG responses were HTTP 200; it does not mean the native JPEG full/thumb targets were available.

exact_target_identity_source.note: Browser result reports observed runtime only; exact full/thumb identity is independently supplied by the static package and root acceptance.

interpretation.guide_layers: See guide_layers for separate browser-decoded preview metrics and local v39 Pillow decode of the three guide-image collections.
